explanation: Found while building CaissaTrainer's shell. Summa-UI's AppShell is a fixed 252px sidebar (.shell-side) that becomes a drawer under 820px; there is no middle state. A workspace page needs the room, so CaissaTrainer added a 56px icon rail (labels move to aria-label and title, the width toggle is a nav item at the bottom) between the expanded 224px sidebar and the mobile drawer. Mode is chosen by the route (workspace routes default to the rail, document-like pages to expanded) and an explicit user choice always wins. This is still one navigation sidebar, so P14 is not violated, but the pattern needs to exist in Summa-UI so apps do not each invent a rail. Reference: CaissaTrainer AppSidebar.vue, useSidebarMode.ts.

classification.rationale: The shell has only a fixed 252px sidebar and a drawer. A compact icon rail is a recurring middle state for workspace pages. Possible tension with P14 (no sidebar stacking) is not a conflict because it is one sidebar, but the owner should confirm; suggested DECISIONS note is in the proposal draft.
